# Fleetify

## Open-source command center for your AI coding agents

4 followers

## Open-source command center for your AI coding agents

4 followers

Fleetify is a free, open-source desktop app for running AI coding agents side by side. Start sessions with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and seven more agents, or with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter and local Ollama models. Watch them all from the Fleet hub: status, spend, tokens and live activity. Give each task its own git worktree, preview your dev server, open PRs, and install a plugin once for every agent that supports it. macOS, Windows, Linux.

## An Open Letter from Our Founder

# A New Day for Trucking

As we look at trucking today, we see something incredible: the physical backbone of America trapped in a system not built for its success. Millions of hardworking truckers, driven, determined, and committed, are often held back by outdated systems and predatory practices.

It's time for that to change. [...] That's not a dream. It's what we're building at Fleetify. An AI-first platform that puts real power back where it belongs: in the hands of truckers. Tools that maximize revenue, eliminate inefficiencies, and level the playing field. Not because it's easy, but because it's right.

The future of trucking won't be written by those who accept the status quo. It will be built by those bold enough to challenge it. By the dreamers and the doers. By the truckers who refuse to settle for less than they deserve.

That future starts now.

Michael Steele
